deviations: D1 (GoOffline already-offline returns 409): Design says '409 for truthfulness' for the case where driver tries to go offline while already offline. WI text says 'pick 409 for truthfulness, document'. Implemented as 409 with error code Driver.AlreadyOffline. Documented in endpoint Summary.

D2 (DELETE = soft delete / deactivate): Vehicle DELETE sets IsActive=false rather than removing the row. This preserves referential integrity with historical orders and driver shifts. Documented in endpoint Summary and description.

D3 (Duplicate plate check is app-level): No unique index on (fleet_id, plate) in this WI. The duplicate-plate check is an application-level AnyAsync query. A TOCTOU race condition is theoretically possible but accepted for this low-concurrency operation. Documented in endpoint Summary.
D4 (AsFleetAdmin added to AuthHelpers): AsFleetAdmin(fleetId, userId?, fleetSlug?) helper added to AuthHelpers.cs to mirror AsDispatcher. Required for vehicle CRUD tests which are FleetAdminOnly.
D5 (GoOnline/GoOffline response is 204): Both GoOnline and GoOffline return 204 No Content. The WI did not specify a response body; 204 is idiomatic for action endpoints that don't return a resource.

D6 (Round 2 review fixes — F1+F2): Removed required keyword from all 8 string properties on CreateVehicleRequest and UpdateVehicleRequest. Changed to plain string with = string.Empty; initializer. NotEmpty validators already produce 400; required caused STJ JsonException on missing key → 500 via global handler.
D7 (Round 2 review fixes — F3): Moved VehicleDto from ListVehiclesResponse.cs into its own file VehicleDto.cs per rules/architecture.md#one-type-per-file.

D8 (Round 2 review fixes — F5 optional test): Added GoOnline_InactiveVehicle_Returns404 covering the already-coded v.IsActive guard path. Test was immediately green (no TDD cycle needed) — this is coverage for existing behavior per reviewer suggestion F5, not a new feature.
